sources.entry: AirServer - Most advanced screen mirroring software receiver for Mac, PC and Xbox One.

summary.name: AirServer Connect
summary.one_liner: AirServer is a screen mirroring receiver app that lets Mac and Windows computers receive AirPlay and other screen mirroring streams.
use_cases: Mirror an iPhone or iPad screen to a Mac or PC
Receive AirPlay streams on a Windows computer
Display a laptop screen wirelessly on a larger monitor or TV
Install AirServer from the Microsoft Store or as an MSIX/MSI package
Mirror a device screen for presentations or classroom demos
summary.what_it_does: The page is a download page for AirServer, a screen mirroring receiver for Windows and Mac. It describes installing the app from the Microsoft Store on Windows 10 or from a disk image on Mac. Licenses are activated with an activation key or code. The page also offers an MSIX package for users without Microsoft Store access and a classic MSI package for older Windows versions. The page text itself does not detail specific mirroring features beyond the listing's description of it as a receiver for Mac, PC and Xbox One.
notable: Installs via Microsoft Store, MSIX, or classic MSI package on Windows
Offers a free trial for a limited time
caveats: Requires a license activation key or code after trial
Page says a free trial is available only for a limited time
Classic MSI version is for Windows 7/8/10 only, per the page
